safety.method: Read-only SELECT of migration metadata; no business rows or SQL body export in the ledger fingerprint snapshot. Selected stored SQL bodies were separately compared as described in the companion mapping report.
limitations: A mapped path is not proof that the live stored SQL equals the repository file.
MD5(statements::text) is a serialized ledger fingerprint, not a cryptographic attestation or semantic SQL equivalence proof.
The historical 93-entry report records 92 normalized text matches and one redacted environment-specific identity mapping.
The 22-row forward delta records repository source hashes; live SQL hash verification is not claimed except where separately evidenced.
The 14-row Production tail includes placeholders, archive/quarantine artifacts and a redacted cleanup artifact; these are not replayable migrations.
Production and QA have divergent baselines and only three shared version IDs, all with different names and fingerprints. Never align by blind replay or manual ledger insertion.
Effective catalog/function/ACL parity is a separate reconciliation workstream; migration source mapping alone does not prove effective schema equivalence.
